strings.name: Ava DuVernay
strings.summary: A former publicist, DuVernay became the first Black woman to win Sundance’s dramatic directing prize. Selma, 13 th and When They See Us examine civil rights, incarceration and injustice; ARRAY supports overlooked filmmakers. In 2026 she prepared 14 th for release, continuing her examination of American institutions and historical memory.

strings.influence.rationale: Films and series including Selma and 13 th examine civil rights, justice systems and Black historical memory.
